The '''Polan-717 Jedi transport''', also simply known as the '''Polan''', was a type of [[shuttle]] utilized by the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. The shuttle was manufactured by [[Lantillian ShipWrights]]. It was very versatile for both everyday and long-distance missions.<ref name="Databank Polan" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|When I talked about the Polan, Leslye just said, 'It's a caravan for Jedi police.' Because in a funny way, we're watching a police drama. So I gave it the sensibility of a traveling vehicle where everything they ever need is in there rather than a freighter.|Kevin Jenkins|<ref name="Ars Technica">{{WebCite|url=https://arstechnica.com/culture/2024/06/star-wars-behind-the-scenes-creating-the-unique-aesthetic-of-the-acolyte|text=Star Wars behind the scenes: Creating the unique aesthetic of ''The Acolyte''|author=Jennifer Ouellette|date=2024-06-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Ars Technica|''Ars Technica'']]|archivedate=20240704230817}}</ref>}}
The Polan-717 Jedi transport first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]"<ref name="Lost / Found" /> and "[[Revenge / Justice]],"<ref name="Revenge / Justice">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref> the first and second episodes of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired simultaneously on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Prior to the premiere of ''The Acolyte'', the Polan was first pictured in the series' trailer on [[March 19]] of that year,<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}}</ref> before being identified in an entry on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]]<ref name="Databank Polan" /> published on [[May 4]].<ref name="Final Trailer">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-trailer|text=Darkness Rises in ''The Acolyte'' Final Trailer and Key Art}}</ref>

The Polan was named in memoriam of a friend of showrunner [[Leslye Headland]].<ref name="T/C Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=teach-corrupt-trivia-gallery-the-acolyte|text="Teach / Corrupt" Trivia Gallery | The Acolyte}}</ref> In discussions with production designer [[Kevin Jenkins]], Headland described the Polan as a caravan for Jedi police, leading Jenkins to design the vessel such that it contained everything they would require. Due to ''The Acolyte'' being set in a new era, the series' spacecraft were given a fresh design vernacular.<ref name="Ars Technica" />
